class.name: OcgTdocstdXlink
class.brief_description: An attribute to store the path and the entry of external links. These refer from one data structure to a data structure in another document.
class.description: ! An attribute to store the path and the entry of ! external links. ! These refer from one data structure to a data ! structure in another document.

method.name: Update
method.description: Updates the data referenced in this external link attribute.

method.name: ID
method.description: Returns the ID of the attribute.

method.name: LabelEntry_2
method.description: Sets the label entry for this external link attribute with the label aLabel. aLabel pilots the importation of data from the document entry.

method.name: AfterAddition
method.description: Updates the XLinkRoot attribute by adding <me> to its list.

method.name: BeforeRemoval
method.description: Updates the XLinkRoot attribute by removing <me> from its list.

method.name: BackupCopy
method.description: Returns a null handle. Raise always for it is nonsense to use this method.

method.name: Set
method.description: Sets an empty external reference, at the label aLabel.

method.name: GetID
method.description: Returns the GUID for external links.
